picks.file: Civitates orbis terrarum. De praecipuis totius universi urbibus. Liber secundus (page 110).jpg
picks.what: Bird’s-eye view, engraving in Braun and Hogenberg, Civitates Orbis Terrarum, vol. 2
picks.why: colored true view of the island city in its lakes; highest-resolution copy; book page trimmed
only usable view between 1650 and 1850; Dutch and French captions trimmed

picks.what: View from the Anconetta, wood engraving in Le Cento Città d’Italia
picks.why: skyline across the lake with the dome of Sant’Andrea

picks.file: Mantova riflessa nel Lago Superiore. - panoramio.jpg
picks.what: The skyline reflected in the Lago Superiore, photograph
picks.why: the classic skyline: Sant’Andrea’s dome, the cathedral bell tower and medieval towers

gaps: P0: nothing. P3: only #11, an etching dated just ‘early 18th century’. P5: Mittelholzer’s 1928 aerial (#15) shows the city as a small gray patch among fields from 2,000 m, too weak; the 1941–47 item is a photomap.
notes: #8 is Allard’s re-engraving of the Braun and Hogenberg composition, so it shows the city much as in 1575; drop it if derivative copies are unwanted (#7 and #9 are the same plate, #9 bound small in a book). #2 is a cleaner single-sheet color copy of the 1575 plate at lower resolution (2953 px). #15 could serve as a P5 fallback with a tight trim around the city.
